name: 9-Line MEDEVAC Request
description: Casualty evacuation request. Lines 1-2 (location, radio) are extracted by code; lines 3-9 are scored by Jev. Defensive/humanitarian framing — no routing, outcome is a MEDEVAC card.

items.label: Precedence
items.follow_up: Confirm precedence: urgent, urgent-surgical, priority, routine, or convenience?
items.jev_question: Line 3, precedence of the evacuation request, one of: A urgent (life, limb, or eyesight threatening, needs evac within 1 hour), B urgent surgical (urgent and needs surgical intervention), C priority (needs prompt care, evac within 4 hours), D routine (evac within 24 hours), E convenience.

items.label: Special equipment
items.follow_up: Confirm special equipment needed at the pickup site.
items.jev_question: Line 4, special equipment required at the pickup site: A none, B hoist, C extraction equipment, D ventilator.

items.label: Patient type
items.follow_up: Confirm patient type: litter, ambulatory, or both.
items.jev_question: Line 5, number/type of patients: L litter (cannot walk, must be carried), A ambulatory (can walk/sit unassisted), or both litter and ambulatory patients present.

items.label: Security at pickup
levels: E - Enemy troops in area, approach with caution
items.follow_up: Confirm security status at the pickup site.
items.jev_question: Line 6, security at the pickup site: N no enemy troops in area, P possible enemy troops in area (approach with caution), E enemy troops in area (approach with caution), X armed escort required.

items.label: Marking
items.follow_up: Confirm how the pickup site will be marked.
items.jev_question: Line 7, method of marking the pickup site: A panels, B pyrotechnic signal, C smoke signal, D none, E other (specify).

items.label: Nationality/status
items.jev_question: Line 8, patient nationality and status: A US military, B US civilian, C non-US military, D non-US civilian, E enemy prisoner of war (EPW).

items.label: NBC contamination
items.jev_question: Line 9, NBC (nuclear/biological/chemical) contamination at the pickup site: N none, C chemical, B biological, R radiological, NUC nuclear.
